### problem_chain
Root P8 (patient declines external review). Gate on this world: denied; appeal rows 2 ≥ 2; HMO external_review_available true; MONTHS(2026-08-21, 2026-10-22) = 2 < 4. P8's rule carries three prerequisite sentences:
1. "The external-review close-out is fixed only after the payer's recovery of its payment stands as a recovery entry on the claim." No claim_takeback row ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P5 (agent, value_input `recovered`). P5's own gate: denied, appeal rows 2 ≥ 2; P5 has no prerequisite.
2. "The external-review close-out is fixed only after any advanced imaging lacking its own authorization carries its no-authorization write-off entry on the claim." 71275 + Q9967 on a non-emergency account; no NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED row ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P6 (agent, value_input `imaging_booked`). P6's rule: "The unauthorized-imaging value is fixed only after the payer's recovery of its payment stands as a recovery entry on the claim." ⇒ P6 ← P5 (value_input `recovered`; P6 = 0.00 on the opening world).
3. "The patient's external-review decision is not recorded until every self-administered drug on the account carries its non-covered write-off entry on the claim." 0637 lines; payment posted; no NONCOVERED_NO_WAIVER row ⇒ unmet. Resolved by P7 (agent, state_gate).
Tree: P8 ← {P5, P6, P7}, P6 ← P5. 3 prerequisite problems, 3 value_input edges, owner=user root, acyclic. Order: P5 → P6; P7 anywhere before P8; P8 last.
Load-bearing: skip P5 → P6 and P8 both 0.00; skip P6 → root 4299.56; skip P7 → root unchanged 2444.20 (state_gate, ordering weight). P5/P6 interaction is the declared edge; P7 shares nothing with them.
Tools judge nothing (task_tools.py bodies). Persona raises only the root; "If they explain that Riverbend has some things of its own to settle on the claim first ..." is reactive.

## findings
1. **SOURCE-TASK RED (root cause charter C1) — two defensible root writes.** Symptom: on this claim P4 and P8 both fire on the patient's refusal. Evidence: P4 rule "On a claim in denied status whose provider-level appeal levels are all used (its highest appeal level filed is at least the payer class's available appeal levels), the remaining member-level appeal belongs to the patient; when the patient decides in person not to pursue it ... one write-off entry with the write-off reason APPEALS_EXHAUSTED"; world: status denied, appeal_level 2, Commercial HMO appeal_levels_available 2; persona: "You will not request the external review, and you are not going to ask Network Health for anything else either; if the representative asks, that is your answer". P4's three prerequisite sentences are empty on this account (no 0278 lines; P2 = 0.00 on an Observation Stay Account; no convenience-list items). Second reading: hand over close_denial_on_member_decision_7cc13d5d(c0bcf67a, 5584.80) (10740.00 × 52%, every P4 factor on its fall-through for an observation account at Neenah) — with or without P5–P7. GT: P5, P6, P7 then close_denial_on_external_review_decision 2444.20. Base dedup admits only one (CO-50, APPEALS_EXHAUSTED) row; no rule ranks P8 over P4. Affected: P4 and P8 rules (scope), task 1 steps 13–14.
2. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C7) — lab items payable or not on this observation stay.** P2 (in force on this claim, evaluates 0.00): "on an Inpatient Admission Account or an Observation Stay Account the laboratory items are part of the stay's per-diem and carry no separate value"; P5: the laboratory tests are "retained diagnostic tests, which its payer agreements keep payable as outpatient diagnostics", valued here at 77.23 (84484 52.49 + 85025 10.49 + 80053 14.26). Taking P2's premise into P5's retained value gives retained 653.00, retained payment 503.00, refund 4900.60 instead of GT 4823.37 (and P6/P8 caps move with it). Affected: P2 and P5 rules; step 8.
3. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED — false proof assertion.** `computations[claim_ext_unauthorized_imaging_closeout].factor_sensitivity[contrast_handling].tier_taken` names the Medicare Advantage/Original Medicare/BadgerCare packaging tier; the claim is a Commercial HMO Claim (`insurance_claims.c0bcf67a.variant_name`), the compute takes `contrast_method` 2 (per millilitre, 80 × 0.42 = 33.60). The figure (882.29) is right; the tier statement is not. Affected: tasks/1.json computations.
4. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C8, realism) — CT angiography in an observation stay written off as NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED under CO-50.** Claim denied CO-50/N130 as a not-medically-necessary stay; prior_auth_number AU2263018 present; imaging done during the observation stay. P6: "every advanced-imaging line on the account lacks its own authorization". Consequence: GT step 10 posts (CO-50, NO_AUTHORIZATION_OBTAINED, 868.67) for imaging no payer requires separate authorization for during an observation stay and that the payer never denied for authorization. Affected: P6 framing; step 10.
5. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C14, XF D17)** — the recovery row is "recorded ... against the remittance that carried the claim's payment" (tool copies EFT22648203 / 2026-05-06) while base says "against the remittance that carried it" (overwrite: []); base `recoupment_dispute_window` anchored on that date shows 60 days long expired on the posting day. No scored-value change. Affected: P5 rule, refund tool.
6. **SOURCE-POLICY RED (C13, XF B12)** — P5 "at the payer's request" and P7 "with no advance financial-responsibility waiver among the claim's records" rest on no record. No value change.
7. **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (charter structure) inside this task's computations**: F1 — P5 echocardiogram_contract_fee, ecg_tracing_fee, ecg_tracings_counted, lab_fee_schedule_multiplier; P6 ct_angiography_fee, contrast_rate_per_ml; P7 self_pay_dose_price, pharmacy_dispensing_fee, sad_doses_counted; P8 observation_case_rate_band. F4 — P6 ct_angiography_fee and contrast_rate_per_ml fall-throughs (690.00, 0.35) reach no customer. Each still moves its figure on this world; after strikes P5 keeps 2, P6 3 (1 parameter), P7 1 factor.
8. Observation — the 2026-05-06 remittance does not balance (10740.00 billed vs 5403.60 + 5126.40 + 150.00 = 10680.00): the 60.00 of 0637 lines carry no remittance line, which a balanced 835 would report (e.g. as non-covered); GT rationale says it was left open on purpose. No scored-value change.
9. Observation — C10: the P5/P8 gates count the provider reconsideration as one of the "internal appeal levels"; here the persona's payer letter offers external review, so no task consequence beyond feeding finding 1.
